user.description: User name in the container; its home is /home/USER (default: agent).

uid.description: uid the container runs as (default: yours).

gid.description: gid the container runs as (default: yours).

docker.description: Docker compatible command to run (default: docker).

defaults.description: Sandbox properties applied to every sandbox. A sandbox's own values override them; objects (resources, env) merge key by key.
